name: Desmethoxyyangonin
summary: Desmethoxyyangonin (DMY) or 5,6-dehydrokavain is one of the six main kavalactones found in the Piper methysticum (kava) plant. It is a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase B (MAO-B), likely contributing to increased dopamine levels in the brain's nucleus accumbens and supporting kava's attention-enhancing effects. Unlike other kavalactones, it does not modulate GABAA receptors.
